settlement_source: Rotten Tomatoes (rottentomatoes.com) All Critics Tomatometer score for the named movie
settlement_variable: Integer Tomatometer % (All Critics) at 10:00 AM ET on the Monday after wide release; strike 'above N' (strictly greater)
tie_handling: Strictly above: score == strike resolves NO; 'between' is inclusive of both bounds
rounding: Whole-number percent as displayed by RT; no further rounding specified
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading time = 10:00 AM ET Monday after wide release; expiration_time ~7 days later; settlement no later than day after expiration unless under review. Sample: close 2026-11-02T15:00Z, expiration 2026-11-09T15:00Z
early_close_or_void_clauses: If no data at 10:00 ET Monday, Tuesday 10:00 ET value used; if none a week after Monday, ALL markets resolve No. Kalshi may open Market Outcome Review at sole discretion. can_close_early=1. Post-expiration RT revisions ignored.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says Rotten Tomatoes score - rules specify only the All Critics Tomatometer (not Audience/Popcornmeter, not Top Critics)
Score is frozen at one timestamp (Mon 10:00 ET), not the final/peak score
Fresh/Certified Fresh subtitles are illustrative only; threshold is numeric
Markets can open long before release (Godzilla opened Sep 22 for Nov 9 close) when no score exists; no-data fallback resolves No

public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.name: Rotten Tomatoes movie page (live Tomatometer)
public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.latency: real-time, updates as reviews are added

toxicity_flags: Settlement variable is publicly visible live for days before close; prices may lag score drift near strike
Score near strike can flip with few late reviews (small review count before wide release)
Thin books at extreme strikes (Above 5 bid 0/ask 0.01) - spread-driven fake edge
Pin risk at the 10:00 ET snapshot / late review timing
Insider restriction: RT reviewers/employees prohibited; MNPI prohibition
notes: Mostly information-arrival market: live RT score vs strike is directly observable; edge is modeling remaining review drift. RT page not fetched (JS-heavy); feed latencies are general knowledge, not verified.
